tools.name: analyze_abstract
tools.description: Analyze an academic paper abstract for structural completeness (Background, Methods, Results, Conclusion), readability, and academic rigor with actionable improvement suggestions.

abstract.description: The full text of the academic abstract to analyze.

tools.name: generate_conference_names
tools.description: Generate creative, publication-ready academic event names and acronyms tailored to topic, audience, region, tone, and format.

topic.description: The main topic or theme of the conference.

tone.description: Tone style for the conference name.

count.description: Number of name suggestions to generate (1-10).

tools.name: get_calendar_feed
tools.description: Generate live iCal calendar subscription links and feeds for academic conference submission deadlines.

q.description: Optional keyword filter for calendar events.

tools.name: navigate_to_page
tools.description: Navigate the browser to a specific URL path on CallForPaper.org (e.g. "/discover", "/pricing", "/tools/calendar-generator").

path.description: The URL path to navigate to.

tools.name: search_cfps
tools.description: Search active academic calls for papers and research events on CallForPaper.org. Use this when finding conferences, workshops, CFPs, submission opportunities, deadlines, or academic events. Supports filtering by research subject, country, sort order, and keyword.

q.description: Search keywords or topic (e.g. "Machine Learning", "Digital Humanities", "NeurIPS").

sort.description: Sort ordering for results. Defaults to deadline.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return (1-25). Defaults to 10.
